text: Because the main mandate of a fair launch is equitable treatment of the public, fair launches typically involve a mandate to distribute any and all revenue and profits of the project to community investors.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
abstract: Since the main mandate of the fair launch is equitable treatment of the public, fair launches typically involve a mandate to distribute any and all revenue and profits of the project to their community investors.
